name: EmergencyResponse

custom.system_prompt: You are generating a conversations during emergency response to an accident where a dog was hurt.

sound_effects_config.default_background: dog park ambiance, nature sounds in the background

initial_prompt: Create a conversation during a response to a dog accident where owners discuss how to take care of the pet and get help quickly.

user1.name: PetOwner
user1.tts_prompt: Frightened but caring pet owner tone

user1.name: Aisha
user1.tts_prompt: Calm and caring pet owner tone

variations.context: Emergency response to an accident involving a dog in a park, where the owner is trying to quickly assess the situation and get help while keeping the dog calm.

setting.relationship_dynamic: Pet owner carying for their pet
setting.background: They use their home assistant to call for help and assess the situation

scenario_template.topic: Observing the dog playing in the park
scenario_template.note: Observing dogs playing in the park

scenario_template.topic: Noticing the dog's paw is hurt
scenario_template.note: Dog comes to the owners visibly panicked

scenario_template.topic: Examining the injury
scenario_template.note: Assistant helps to identify the problem and gives first aid instructions

scenario_template.topic: Keeping the dog calm
scenario_template.note: User tries to calm their dog by speaking gently and petting them.

scenario_template.topic: Recalling a similar past incident
scenario_template.note: User recalls a previous incident when the dog got hurt and how they managed it.

scenario_template.topic: Calling a friend for moral support
scenario_template.note: User calls a friend for advice and comfort, while the assistant offers to connect the call.

scenario_template.topic: Noticing other people watching the incident
scenario_template.note: User notices people in the park watching the situation, adding a layer of self-conscious urgency.

scenario_template.topic: Remembering a nearby open vet clinic
scenario_template.note: User suddenly recalls a vet clinic they passed by earlier that might be open, prompting a quick decision.

scenario_template.topic: Looking for a vet
scenario_template.note: Assistant helps to find the closest vet and gives directions while the owner prepares to leave the park

scenario_template.topic: He says it looked like a chicken bone, which is the bad one.
